description: This file defines the ObjectCopier class in the Aws\S3 namespace, responsible for copying objects between S3 locations, utilizing multipart copy when needed. It includes methods for performing asynchronous and synchronous copy operations, handles validation, and manages related external class dependencies.

classes.name: ObjectCopier
classes.description: Handles copying S3 objects with support for multipart copying and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ObjectCopier with client configuration, source, destination, ACL, and options.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Performs the copy asynchronously, returning a promise that fulfills with the operation result.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Performs the copy operation synchronously and returns the result.

methods.name: validateLocation
methods.description: Validates that a given location array has non-empty 'Bucket' and 'Key' entries.

methods.name: getSourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the source path string for the object, including handling ARNs and version IDs.
